description: RSS/VSZ sampled over a window; Node: heap snapshot with top retainers by retained size; Python: py-spy dump (locals: true adds variable values). Node targets without --inspect need consent: true (SIGUSR1 opens the inspector until the process exits). Take two and diff_runs them to find what grows.

consent.description: Node targets without --inspect: required to send SIGUSR1, which leaves Node's inspector open on 127.0.0.1 until the process exits. Ask the user first.

heap.description: Take a heap snapshot where supported (Node). Set false for metrics only.

locals.description: Python: include local variable values in the stack dump (may contain user data or secrets). Off by default.

window_s.description: Sample RSS over this many seconds
